_meta: 영어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 미국 말투 한 벌. 여성판 이름은 고정 인물 Emma 와 겹치지 않게 Sara.
base_text: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I got everything ready this morning. When it's over, let's grab dinner together, okay?

am.desc: A young American man in his twenties, clear and gentle voice, neutral American accent

af.desc: A young American woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice, neutral American accent

maya.desc: An American woman in her early twenties from New York, fast, bright and expressive voice with big reactions

emma.desc: An American woman in her early twenties, calm, soft and slightly teasing voice

jake.desc: An American man in his mid twenties, relaxed, laid-back and slightly deep voice

daniel.desc: An American man in his mid twenties, direct, steady and warm low voice

man_y.desc: An American man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: An American man in his forties from New York, steady and dry voice

man_o.desc: An American man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice

woman_y.desc: An American woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: An American woman in her forties, composed and kind voice

woman_o.desc: An American woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice

kid.desc: An American child around eight years old, small and bright voice

announce.desc: A clear, even female announcer voice, like a subway or airport announcement

robot.desc: A flat synthetic machine voice, like a kiosk or payment terminal

neutral.ref: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I got everything ready this morning.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff
polite.ref: Good afternoon. Your order is ready. Please let me know if you need anything else.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite
stiff.ref: Thank you very much for your time today. I will do my very best. It is an honor to be here.

cheerful.ref: Oh, you made it! The weather is so nice, today is going to be a great day.

amused.ref: Ha, that's so funny! Okay, okay, keep going, I want to hear the rest.

teasing.ref: Oh really? You just happened to be here? Sure you did. I totally believe you.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud
excited.ref: No way, we actually got the tickets! This is the best thing that has ever happened!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps
surprised.ref: Wait, what? You're telling me this was here the whole time? I had no idea!

shout.instruct: surprised and loud, an exaggerated comic retort
shout.ref: Hey! Stop right there! You forgot your bag! Come back!

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond
tsukkomi.ref: Are you serious right now? That is not even close to what I said!

annoyed.ref: This is the third time today. Can you please just put it back where it was?

sad.ref: I thought it would be different this time. I guess it doesn't really matter anymore.

worried.ref: Are you okay? You haven't answered all day, and I really don't know what to do.

flustered.ref: No, no, that's not what I meant! I was just, I mean, can we forget I said that?

shy.ref: I don't know how to say this. I just, um, I kind of like being around you.

gentle.ref: Hey, it's okay. Take your time. I'm not going anywhere, I'll wait right here.
